name: My Dear Friend
source:
Kris has been spending their weeks staying inside their home and neglecting their duties. Maybe it's time for them to go out and take a fresh air? Or maybe they should stay inside and do their homework. Whichever path they choose, they just can't seem to avoid a certain someone.

[From [url=https://echonoahh.itch.io/my-dear-friend]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
克里斯这几个星期一直呆在家里，忽视了自己的职责。也许他们是时候出去呼吸新鲜空气了？或者也许他们应该呆在家里做作业。无论他们选择哪条路，他们似乎都无法回避某个人。

[来自[url=https://echonoahh.itch.io/my-dear-friend]itch.io[/url]]
